description: A high-volume children's hospital with paediatric intensivists on site. Almost the mirror image of the rural centre: deep paediatric expertise and data, thin adult coverage, and enough staff that ESI 3 can be seen faster than the reference protocol assumes. Demonstrates that the same assistant serves a specialty mix by changing data, not code.

ruleOverrides.note: Retained at urgent. A paediatric centre sees a very high volume of febrile children; escalating all of them would swamp the department and is the over-triage failure mode.
Adult ischaemic presentations are out of scope for this site; adults arriving here are stabilised and transferred under a separate pathway.
